title: Pure Three Musketeers
summary: Yugi Muto's Three Musketeers of Face Cards (Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight) is a LIGHT Warrior swarm, Fusion, and Tribute-engine powered by Joker's Straight, Joker's Knight, and Imperial Bower! Activate Joker's Straight to discard 1 card, Special Summon Queen's Knight from your Deck, search King's Knight, and immediately Normal Summon King's Knight—which triggers to Special Summon Jack's Knight directly from your Deck! With all three Face Card Musketeers on the field from a single Spell, you can either fuse them into Arcana Knight Joker (via Face Card Fusion using a material from your Deck!) or Royal Straight Slasher, OR wait until your opponent's Main Phase and fire the Quick-Play Spell Thunderspeed Summon to search and immediately Tribute Summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using your three Knights while Joker's Straight and Joker's Knight recycle themselves in the End Phase to fill your hand!

allow.Slifer the Sky Dragon: Yugi's Level 10 DIVINE boss that is directly searched AND Tribute Summoned during your opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase by Thunderspeed Summon using Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight!
allow.Unexpected Dai: Normal Spell that Special Summons Level 4 Normal Monster Queen's Knight directly from your Deck while you control no monsters—so Normal Summoning King's Knight immediately pulls Jack's Knight from your Deck!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Imperial Bower, King's Knight, or Queen's Knight from your Deck.
allow.Constellar Pleiades: Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (accessible under Joker's Straight's LIGHT Warrior Extra Deck lock!) summoned using Level 5 Jack's Knight + Level 5 Joker's Knight that bounces a card on the field as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 39: Utopia: Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (accessible under Joker's Straight's LIGHT Warrior Extra Deck lock!) summoned using Level 4 Queen's Knight + Level 4 King's Knight.
allow.Number S39: Utopia the Lightning: Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (accessible under Joker's Straight's LIGHT Warrior Extra Deck lock!) stacked over Number 39: Utopia to reach 5000 ATK during damage calculation.

main: Joker's Knight

Core Level 5 LIGHT Warrior extender (2000 ATK): sends Queen's Knight, King's Knight, or Jack's Knight from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from your hand and copy that sent monster's name; during each End Phase, returns 1 other LIGHT Warrior from your GY to the Deck to add itself from your GY back to your hand!
Imperial Bower

Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior starter: while you control no other monsters, tributes itself to add or Special Summon 2 different monsters from your Deck among 'Queen's Knight', 'King's Knight', and 'Jack's Knight'!
King's Knight

Signature Musketeer (Level 4 LIGHT Warrior, 1600 ATK): when Normal Summoned while you control 'Queen's Knight' (including a Joker's Knight copying Queen's Knight's name!), Special Summons 1 'Jack's Knight' directly from your Deck!
Queen's Knight

Signature Musketeer (Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Normal Monster, 1500 ATK): Special Summoned from your Deck by Joker's Straight, Imperial Bower, and Unexpected Dai to turn on King's Knight and Face Card Fusion!
Jack's Knight
Signature Musketeer (Level 5 LIGHT Warrior Normal Monster, 1900 ATK): Special Summoned from your Deck by King's Knight and Imperial Bower to complete the Three Musketeers trio!
Arcana Triumph Joker

Level 10 LIGHT Warrior boss: sends Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight from hand/field to GY to Special Summon itself from your hand or GY, gains 500 ATK per card in both hands, and discards a card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) to destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls of that same type!
Royal Straight Slasher
Level 6 LIGHT Warrior boss: Special Summoned by Royal Straight; sends 5 monsters to the GY to destroy all cards your opponent controls.
Slifer the Sky Dragon

Searched from your Deck and immediately Tribute Summoned on the opponent's turn by Thunderspeed Summon using your 3 Face Card Musketeers, gaining +2000 ATK every End Phase when Joker's Straight and Joker's Knight return to your hand!
Joker's Straight

Core Normal Spell: discards 1 card, Special Summons 'Queen's Knight' from your Deck, adds 'King's Knight' or 'Jack's Knight' from your Deck to your hand, and immediately Normal Summons 1 monster (Normal Summoning King's Knight to pull Jack's Knight from your Deck!); returns a LIGHT Warrior from GY during the End Phase to add itself back to your hand!
Face Card Fusion

Normal Spell: Fusion Summons 1 LIGHT Warrior Fusion Monster (Arcana Knight Joker!) from your Extra Deck using monsters from your hand or field—and if you control Queen's Knight, King's Knight, or Jack's Knight, you can also use 1 monster directly from your DECK as Fusion Material!
Thunderspeed Summon

Signature Quick-Play Spell: during the Main Phase or Battle Phase, immediately Normal Summons 1 Level 10 monster—or if you control 'Queen's Knight', 'King's Knight', and 'Jack's Knight', first adds 1 Level 10 non-DARK monster with ? ATK (Slifer the Sky Dragon!) from your Deck to your hand, and then immediately Tribute Summons it!
Royal Straight
Quick-Play Spell that sends Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight from your hand/field to the GY to Special Summon Royal Straight Slasher, Arcana Triumph Joker, or Arcana Knight Joker.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Queen's Knight directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Imperial Bower or King's Knight.
Joker's Wild

Normal Trap: during the Main or Battle Phase, sends a Spell that mentions Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight (Joker's Straight, Thunderspeed Summon, or Face Card Fusion!) from your Deck to the GY to copy its effect; recycles a LIGHT Warrior in the End Phase to add itself back to your hand!
Court of Cards
Continuous Trap that Special Summons Queen's, King's, or Jack's Knight from your hand or GY and banishes Normal Monsters to draw cards.
extra: Signature Level 9 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss ('Queen's Knight' + 'Jack's Knight' + 'King's Knight'; 3800 ATK): once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect is activated that targets this face-up card (Quick Effect), discards the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap) to negate the activation!

Signature Link-3 LIGHT Warrior boss (3 Warrior monsters with different names; 2800 ATK): negates targeting effects on itself or monsters it points to by discarding the same card type, and floats into Queen's Knight from Deck + searches a Level 4 Warrior when destroyed by battle!
Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 5 LIGHT monsters: Joker's Knight + Jack's Knight; legal under Joker's Straight's LIGHT Warrior lock!) that bounces 1 card on the field to the hand as a Quick Effect.
Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (Queen's Knight + King's Knight) that upgrades into Utopia the Lightning.
Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (legal under Joker's Straight's LIGHT Warrior lock!) that attacks with 5000 ATK and prevents opponent activations during battle.
